title: Global Well-Posedness near Rayleigh-Jeans Equilibria for the Cubic NLS Wave Kinetic Equation
summary: We study the dynamics of the kinetic wave equation associated to the three dimensional Schrödinger equation close to Rayleigh-Jeans equilibria. We first prove that the linearised operator generates a semigroup of contractions in $L^2((0,\infty);\sqrt ω\ddω)$. Considering the family of nonsingular Rayleigh-Jeans spectra, we prove that the linearised operator possesses a spectral gap, despite the non-compactness of the integral collisional operator, and thus obtain an exponential relaxation for the linear semigroup.
